flagged.evidence: The Definition introduces “Let I be a nonempty finite totally ordered set” and assigns points ξ_i only for i∈I, but later says row and column sets may have separate point assignments and starts the block-cluster tree at (I,J). It never introduces J or a point assignment on J. Thus, for a distinct column set, diam(σ) and dist(τ,σ) are undefined under the earlier definitions, so the permitted rectangular case has no defined admissibility or block-cluster tree.
